correctness.rationale: Translate by -1 to get nonnegative coordinates and rank bounds R_k. Ball inclusion yields z_i>=r and sum_I z_i+r sqrt(k)<=R_k. Averaging all k-subsets gives r<=R_k/(k+sqrt(k)); diagonal center attains it. Active rank implies sum z_i<=nr while each z_i>=r so center unique. The perturbed strictly concave rank profile F(k)=k+sqrt(k)+epsilon(|k-m|-m) has unique normalized minimum m, remains positive discretely concave for small epsilon and survives rational scaling, producing strictly positive integer b. Boundary b1=1 excludes redundant contact. Independently checked explicit rank witnesses, but universal proof analytic.
